Frequently Asked Questions

When was Rabbit Maranville born?

Rabbit Maranville was born on November 11, 1891.

Where was Rabbit Maranville born?

Rabbit Maranville was born in Springfield, MA.

How tall was Rabbit Maranville?

Rabbit Maranville was 5-5 (165 cm) tall.

How much did Rabbit Maranville weigh when playing?

Rabbit Maranville weighed 155 lbs (70 kg) when playing.

How many seasons did Rabbit Maranville play?

Rabbit Maranville played 23 seasons.

Is Rabbit Maranville in the Hall of Fame?

Rabbit Maranville was elected into the Hall of Fame in 1954.

What position did Rabbit Maranville play?

Rabbit Maranville was a Shortstop and Second Baseman.

How many hits did Rabbit Maranville have?

Rabbit Maranville had 2,605 hits over his career.

How many home runs did Rabbit Maranville have?

Rabbit Maranville had 28 home runs over his career.

What was Rabbit Maranville's average?

Rabbit Maranville had a .258 average over his career.

How many teams has Rabbit Maranville played for?

Rabbit Maranville played for 5 teams; the Boston Braves, Chicago Cubs, Brooklyn Robins, Pittsburgh Pirates and St. Louis Cardinals.

How many World Series has Rabbit Maranville won?

Rabbit Maranville won 1 World Series.

When did Rabbit Maranville retire?

Rabbit Maranville last played in 1935.
